title: Math: Addition & Subtraction within 100 ➕➖
summary:
1. Addition (Adding / +)
Adding means finding the total or sum of numbers.
Words to look for: total, in all, altogether, sum, more.

2. Subtraction (Subtracting / -)
Subtracting means taking away a number from another to find the difference.
Words to look for: left, difference, fewer, take away, gave away.

3. Number Pairs (Bonds)
Number pairs are two numbers that add up to a specific number.
• Pairs to 20: 14 + 6 = 20, 10 + 10 = 20.
• Pairs to 100: 60 + 40 = 100, 75 + 25 = 100.

questions.questionText: Add the numbers: 8 + 7 = ___
questions.hint: Put 8 in your head and count on 7 fingers.

questions.questionText: Add the numbers: 9 + 6 = ___
questions.hint: Make a 10 first! Take 1 from the 6 to make the 9 a 10.

questions.questionText: Add the numbers: 11 + 8 = ___
Add the numbers: 14 + 6 = ___
questions.hint: Count up 6 times from 14.

questions.questionText: Word Problem: Tom has 12 apples. His mother gives him 5 MORE apples. How many apples does Tom have in total?
questions.hint: The word 'more' means you must Add (+). 12 + 5 = ?

questions.questionText: Subtract the numbers: 15 - 7 = ___
questions.hint: Count backwards from 15.

questions.questionText: Subtract the numbers: 18 - 9 = ___
questions.hint: Remember your doubles! What number plus itself makes 18?

questions.questionText: Subtract the numbers: 20 - 8 = ___
questions.hint: Think of pairs to 10. 10 - 8 = 2, so 20 - 8 = 12.

questions.questionText: Subtract the numbers: 13 - 6 = ___
questions.hint: Take away 3 to get to 10, then take away 3 more.

questions.questionText: Word Problem: Sarah had 16 candies. She ATE 4 of them. How many candies are LEFT?
questions.hint: The words 'ate' and 'left' mean you must Subtract (-). 16 - 4 = ?

questions.questionText: Find the missing number pair to 20: ___ + 3 = 20
questions.hint: Count back 3 steps from 20.

questions.questionText: Find the missing number pair to 100: 60 + ___ = 100
questions.hint: Think of pairs to 10. 6 + 4 = 10, so 60 + 40 = 100.

questions.questionText: Find the missing number pair to 100: ___ + 25 = 100

questions.questionText: Word Problem: There are 42 boys and 36 girls in the school hall. How many children are there ALTOGETHER?
questions.hint: Altogether means you must Add (+). 42 + 36 = ?

questions.questionText: Subtract within 100: 78 - 24 = ___
questions.hint: Subtract the tens (70-20) and the ones (8-4).

questions.questionText: Subtract within 100: 85 - 37 = ___
questions.hint: You cannot do 5 - 7, so you must borrow 10 from the 80!

questions.questionText: Word Problem: A baker made 90 cupcakes. He SOLD 45 of them in the morning. How many cupcakes are LEFT?
questions.hint: The word 'left' means you must Subtract (-). 90 - 45 = ?
